dashboard.label: SOC Home-Lab Detection Dashboard
dashboard.description: Detects brute-force logins, unauthorized account creation and obfuscated PowerShell execution

search.query: index=main EventCode=4625 | bucket _time span=1h | stats count by _time | rename count as "Failed_Logins"
index=main EventCode=4720 | table _time, Subject_Account_Name, Account_Name, ComputerName | rename Subject_Account_Name as "New_Account_Created", Account_Name as "Created_By"

index=main EventCode=4688 New_Process_Name=*powershell* (Process_Command_Line=*EncodedCommand* OR Process_Command_Line=*ExecutionPolicy*Bypass* OR Process_Command_Line=*-enc*) | table _time, Account_Name, New_Process_Name, Process_Command_Line
